See your position.
Read the tactics.

Your game → Lineup / Tactics

Lineup shows who starts and where. Tactics shows the captain’s formation, play style and instructions.

1
Lineup: check your position for this specific game.

After each game,
top up your share.

Home → Top Up Team Credit

After each game, open Top Up Team Credit to pay your share for the game you just played.

1
Pay the listed game amount, or enter the share your captain requested.

Check the total, continue to pay and wait for confirmation.
